comment: Pins the SDK so a local build and a CI build use the same toolchain - a
prerequisite for the reproducible-build claim the package makes (see issue #18).
This pins the *SDK*, not the target frameworks: the library still builds
net472 and net8.0-windows exactly as before.
rollForward=latestFeature accepts any newer 10.0.x SDK (so CI's '10.0.x' install
and a local servicing update both satisfy it) while refusing a silent jump to 11.x.
